# portainer_kubernetes_custom_resource_definition (Data Source)

> **Business Edition only.** This endpoint does not exist in Portainer CE.

Inspects one custom resource definition.

## Example Usage

```hcl
data "portainer_kubernetes_custom_resource_definition" "widgets" {
  endpoint_id = portainer_environment.prod.id
  name        = "widgets.example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `endpoint_id` (Number) Identifier of the Kubernetes environment to query.
- `name` (String) Name of the custom resource definition to inspect.

### Read-Only

- `creation_date` (String) When the definition was created.
- `group` (String) API group the definition belongs to.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the resource.
- `release_name` (String) Helm release that installed the definition, empty when it was not installed by one.
- `release_namespace` (String) Namespace of the Helm release that installed the definition.
- `release_version` (String) Version of the Helm release that installed the definition.
- `scope` (String) Whether the resources are `Namespaced` or `Cluster` scoped. This is what decides whether `portainer_kubernetes_custom_resource` needs a namespace.

## Attributes Reference

`scope` is what decides whether `portainer_kubernetes_custom_resource` needs a `namespace`.
